The interview will spotlight Siren's Tale Vodka's rapid growth within the premium spirits category, the brand's unique origin story, and its expanding presence throughout Southern California and beyond.
"We're excited to join the I-Heart audience and share the Siren's Tale story," said
Brad Starkey, Founder and CEO of Siren's Tale Vodka

. "Our brand was created for consumers who appreciate exceptional craftsmanship, authentic storytelling, and a premium vodka experience. This opportunity allows us to connect directly with spirit enthusiasts and introduce more consumers to the adventure behind the Siren's Tale brand."

Siren's Tale Vodka has quickly established itself as an emerging premium spirits brand inspired by the mystery, adventure, and timeless legends of the sea. Crafted from premium French grain and designed for discerning consumers, the brand combines exceptional quality with distinctive branding that celebrates the beauty, strength, and spirit of adventure.
The radio appearance comes at a time of significant momentum for the company. Siren's Tale Vodka recently earned a
Gold Medal recognition from SD Spirits Festival

, further validating the brand's commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and excellence within the competitive premium vodka category. The award reflects the growing recognition the brand is receiving from industry professionals and consumers alike.
In addition, Siren's Tale Vodka is proud to be a sponsor of the upcoming

, one of the premier spirits events in San Diego. The festival sponsorship provides the brand with another opportunity to engage directly with consumers, industry leaders, distributors, retailers, and hospitality professionals while showcasing its award-winning vodka to thousands of attendees.
"Siren's Tale Vodka represents the next generation of premium spirits brands," said
Sandro Piancone, Chief Executive Officer of Fast Moving Consumer Goods, Inc.

"The combination of outstanding product quality, memorable branding, industry recognition through a Gold Medal award, and participation in major industry events such as the San Diego Spirits Festival positions the brand for continued growth. Brad's appearance on I-Hearts's Bar Cart Friday is another important milestone in building awareness for the Siren's Tale story."
